title: ARK Genomic Revolution ETF (ARKG) Delivers +25% Gains Over 30 Days Amid Genomics Rally
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
# Key Takeaways

* ARKG surged approximately 25% over the last 30 days, driven by a powerful rally across genomics, precision medicine, and AI-enabled drug discovery holdings.
* The fund has gained roughly 54% over the last quarter, reflecting a sustained rotation into innovative healthcare and biotechnology equities.
* Top holdings including [TWST](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TWST/), [TEM](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TEM/), [CRSP](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRSP/), and [TXG](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TXG/) contributed disproportionately to recent gains amid sector-wide momentum.
* Renewed investor appetite for growth-oriented, small- and mid-cap biotechnology names has amplified the fund's upward trajectory.
* Macroeconomic tailwinds, including moderating interest rate expectations, have provided additional support for long-duration innovation assets.

# ARK Genomic Revolution ETF (ARKG) Overview and Portfolio Exposure

The ARK Genomic Revolution ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks long-term growth of capital by investing at least 80% of its assets in domestic and foreign equity securities tied to the genomics revolution. The fund concentrates its exposure in the healthcare sector, with a particular emphasis on biotechnology, life sciences tools and services, and health care technology companies. ARKG typically holds between 40 and 60 positions, though the portfolio has recently carried approximately 33 names, reflecting the fund manager's high-conviction approach.

As of early July 2026, the fund's largest holdings included Twist Bioscience Corp ([TWST](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TWST/)), Tempus AI Inc ([TEM](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TEM/)), CRISPR Therapeutics AG ([CRSP](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRSP/)), 10X Genomics Inc ([TXG](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TXG/)), and Absci Corp ([ABSI](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ABSI/)). The portfolio is heavily tilted toward small- and mid-cap companies, with approximately 40% of assets in small-cap names and another 41% in mid-cap stocks. The fund carries an expense ratio of 0.75% and had net assets of approximately $1.3 billion. This concentrated, innovation-heavy structure makes ARKG highly sensitive to shifts in risk sentiment, sector rotation, and clinical or regulatory catalysts affecting its underlying holdings. I also checked this using Tickeron’s AI Screener to see how the holdings stack up against peers in the sector.

# ARK Genomic Revolution ETF (ARKG) Price Performance: Last 30 Days vs. Quarter

Over the last 30 days, ARKG has advanced approximately 25%, climbing from around $32.85 in mid-June to $41.01 by mid-July 2026. The move was not linear; the fund experienced several sharp upward bursts interspersed with brief consolidation periods, characteristic of momentum-driven rallies in high-beta thematic ETFs.

The quarterly performance has been even more pronounced. From approximately $26.68 in early April, ARKG has surged roughly 54%, marking one of the strongest three-month stretches for the fund in recent years. The rally accelerated in late May and continued through June, with the fund breaking through multiple resistance levels as buying pressure intensified. This sustained upward trend suggests broad-based participation rather than a short-lived spike driven by a single event.

# What Drove ARKG Price in the Last 30 Days

Several converging factors fueled ARKG's 25% advance over the past month. The most significant driver was the powerful rally in the fund's top holdings. Twist Bioscience ([TWST](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TWST/)), a DNA synthesis company, and Tempus AI ([TEM](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TEM/)), an AI-powered precision medicine platform, both experienced substantial price appreciation as investor enthusiasm for the intersection of artificial intelligence and healthcare intensified. CRISPR Therapeutics ([CRSP](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRSP/)) and 10X Genomics ([TXG](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TXG/)) also contributed meaningfully, benefiting from positive clinical developments and growing adoption of genomic analysis tools.

Broader macroeconomic conditions provided a supportive backdrop. Moderating inflation data and shifting expectations around Federal Reserve policy reduced the discount rate applied to future cash flows, disproportionately benefiting long-duration growth assets like those held in ARKG. The biotechnology sector broadly outperformed the wider market during this period, with the small- and mid-cap segment showing particular strength. Additionally, renewed M&A (mergers and acquisitions) speculation across the genomics and precision medicine landscape added a layer of takeover premium to several portfolio companies. Fund inflows into thematic healthcare ETFs also accelerated, creating additional demand pressure on underlying holdings.

# What Drove ARKG Performance Over the Last Quarter

The fund's 54% quarterly surge reflects a broader regime change in market leadership that began taking shape in April 2026. After an extended period of underperformance for innovation-focused strategies, capital began rotating back into high-growth biotechnology and genomics names. This rotation was underpinned by improving fundamentals across the precision medicine industry, including accelerating revenue growth at several top holdings, successful clinical trial readouts, and expanding commercial adoption of gene editing and molecular diagnostics technologies.

Institutional positioning played a meaningful role. After several quarters of outflows from thematic healthcare ETFs, the second quarter of 2026 saw a reversal, with net inflows returning to the category. The fund's concentrated exposure to AI-enabled drug discovery platforms proved especially timely, as the convergence of machine learning and biology emerged as a dominant investment narrative. Large-cap anchor holdings such as Illumina ([ILMN](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ILMN/)) and Natera ([NTRA](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NTRA/)) provided additional stability, while smaller positions amplified returns during risk-on periods. The combination of sector rotation, improving fundamentals, and renewed capital inflows created a powerful tailwind that sustained the rally across the entire quarter.

# ARKG ETF Outlook: What Investors Should Watch Next

Looking ahead, several factors will likely shape ARKG's trajectory. The macroeconomic environment remains central; any shift in interest rate expectations or inflation data could rapidly alter the discount rate applied to the fund's long-duration holdings. The genomics and precision medicine sector is also entering a season of major medical conferences and potential clinical data presentations, which could serve as catalysts for individual holdings and the broader theme.

Investors should monitor the earnings reports and guidance from the fund's largest positions, particularly Twist Bioscience, Tempus AI, CRISPR Therapeutics, and 10X Genomics, as these will provide insight into commercial execution and revenue growth trajectories. Regulatory developments affecting gene editing technologies, diagnostic approvals, and AI-enabled drug discovery platforms also warrant close attention. Capital flows into thematic ETFs will indicate whether the recent rotation into innovation strategies has staying power. While the fund's concentrated, high-beta structure amplifies gains during favorable conditions, it equally magnifies downside risk during periods of sector rotation or risk-off sentiment, making position sizing and portfolio context important considerations for any investor evaluating exposure to the genomics revolution. I’m watching this closely as the next round of data and policy signals comes in.
